$comment: Every entry needs a reason that says why the flaw is not reachable in THIS repo, not merely
that upgrading is inconvenient. Every entry also needs a reviewBy date: the gate fails once it
passes, so an exception cannot quietly become permanent. The gate also fails on entries that no
longer match a finding, so a fixed package cannot leave its exception behind.

accepted.reason: braces <= 3.0.3 has a stack-exhaustion denial of service on a pathological brace pattern, and no patched release exists (first_patched_version is none). It is reached only through the shadcn component-scaffolding CLI (shadcn -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces), a devDependency in both frontends that runs on a developer machine against local paths. It is not in either production bundle: Presentation.WebUI imports only shadcn/tailwind.css (a stylesheet), Presentation.Dashboard imports nothing from it. No untrusted input reaches the pattern matcher. Re-assess when a patched braces ships or shadcn drops the dependency.
